name: Are there any specific considerations for drywall installation in a small bathroom?

mainEntity.name: Are there any specific considerations for drywall installation in a small bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: In a small bathroom, precise measurements and cuts are crucial to minimize waste and ensure a snug fit around fixtures and tight corners. Access can be challenging, requiring careful maneuvering of drywall sheets. Proper ventilation during and after the installation is also important, especially in confined spaces, to aid drying and prevent lingering moisture issues.
acceptedAnswer.description: Small bathrooms require precise cuts for fixtures, careful maneuvering of sheets, and good ventilation to aid drying and prevent moisture issues.
